description: Delete a video, image, text, or shape LEAF layer. Errors on a group.<id> (dissolve it with ungroup_layers instead) and on a pinned layer such as the canvas backdrop. Deleting a video layer also takes everything welded to that clip: its welded audio overlay(s) and its welded caption lines, both of which derive their timing from the clip's trim and have no meaning without it.
